name: $C_4$-Cactoids Are Strictly Median
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every $C_4$-cactoid is median, and the containment is strict.
proof: Gated gluing of edges and $C_4$-trees preserves medianity. The cube $Q_3$ is median but is not a $C_4$-cactoid.
